newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway debt rises on U.S data, investors cautious.
newsitem.headline: Norway debt rises on U.S data, investors cautious.

text.p: 1400 GMT -- Early interest focused on the short end of the market, with domestic buyers short covering just ahead of the release of fresh U.S. data.

Long bonds followed Germany and U.S. Treasuries higher after softer than expected U.S. employment costs and durable goods data. But investors pulled back sending the yield spread slightly wider against German Bunds, dealers said.
"Selling interest came in on the long end after the (U.S.) data. People decided to sell on the uptick," said one player.

"A lot of clients are right on the benchmark of risk at the moment. There's a lot of scepticism in the Norwegian market because of all the U.S. figures due out this week. That's why we're not matching in performance to Germany,"
Short rates were unchanged and the crown weakened slightly from Monday to stand at 4.1015 against the mark at 1400 GMT against 4.0970.
* 2007 bond yield seven basis points lower at 6.12 pct
* Norway over Bunds gap one point wider at 29 points
